articles.title: How to Get Fangsplitter Rod - Fisch Guide - IGN
articles.summary: The Fangsplitter Rod is an item you can unlock in Fisch. There is a series of quests tied to it that you'll need to complete if you want to get it. Expect
articles.body:
The Fangsplitter Rod is an item you can unlock in Fisch . There is a series of quests tied to it that you'll need to complete if you want to get it. Expect to roam around Fisch, collecting specific fish using the Nocturnal Rod. In this guide, we'll be sharing with you how to get the Fangsplitter Rod while playing Fisch.

You can get the Fangsplitter Rod by completing a series of quests from Echo, an NPC that you can find at the Underground Music Venue. You can reach this location by making your way to the Crystal Cove and placing a Chaotic Enchant Relic on the pedestal at that location. By placing the Chaotic Enchant Relic on that pedestal, a dark portal should appear behind it, and you can jump inside it to reach the Underground Music Festival.

There, you'll be looking for an NPC named Echo, who is in the corner, to the right of the entrance the venue. Speak with them, and they'll provide you with the series of quests that you need to complete. Here's a full list of those quests.

If you don't have it already, the Nocturnal Rod is a rod you can purchase from Vertigo. You can reach Vertigo by diving into a strange whirlpool (which should have a glowing light coming out of it).

A Strange Whirlpool can spawn anywhere in the world, so you'll need to drive around to find one. When you do, dive into the whirlpool, and when you get down there, the Nocturnal Rod will be on the ground and available for you to purchase for 11,000.

At the end of each quest, make sure to head back to speak with Echo to learn about the next task.

Perform 7 Perfect Catches on Rubber Ducks using the Nocturnal Rod

The Rubber Duck has a chance to appear in Vertigo. You'll need to make your way into one of the Strange Whirlpools to dive into it. From there, head into the waters to try and catch a Rubber Duck, performing at least 7 perfect catches using the Nocturnal Rod.

Catch a Shiny or Sparkling Withered Colossal Squid

The Colossal Squid has the chance to appear in the open ocean, specifically the Deep Ocean. The best times to catch a Colossal Squid are at night, when it's foggy, and during the winter. You'll want to use Night Shrimp. However, some of the best locations include Snapcap Island, and you can reach that location by heading to GPS coordinates (2600, 150, 2400) .

For the third task, you need to be in-game to complete at least seven full day cycles. That means you need to be there when the day and night cycle. You can help make it faster by using a Sundial Token, which counts for one full cycle. You'll need at least seven if you want to rush through all of the requirements.

Catch and Return a Shiny or Sparkling Distraught Enchant Relic

For this task, you'll need to catch a Shiny or Sparkling Distraught Enchant Relic. This means you need to use a specific rod, the Dreambreaker. You can get that rod by speaking with The Restless One in the Cultist Lair at GPS (4450, -2000, -4675) . You'll need to go through that questline to unlock it.

When you do have it, the Dreambreaker rod has the best chance for you to potentially catch an Enchant Relic with the Distraught while it's nighttime. Not only does it need to be a Distraught Enchant Relic, but it must be Shiny or Sparkling.

Perform 7 Perfect Catches on Megalodons using the Nocturnal Rod

The final step of this questline requires you to perform perfect catches against Megalodons while you are using the Nocturnal Rod. Megalodons only appear during a Megalodon hunt, and you'll need to wait for that event to happen. When it does, make your way over to the Ancient Isle, where you'll be able to catch them at this particular location. You'll have 15 minutes before the area despawns, and you'll need to wait until it appears later on.

Once those have all been completed, you'll receive the Fangsplitter Rod from Echo. Here's a breakdown of this rod's stats.

It also has a 30% chance to give catches the Split trait, increasing a fish's sell value by 9x. Additionally, every time you perform a perfect catch with it, you receive a bat, but you lose three bats when you fail to perform a perfect catch. Every bat you have shrinks the control bar, increases the chance for the Split mutation, and increases progress speed and starting progress.

articles.title: Magic: The Gathering’s Star Trek Booster Box Got Another Price Drop Right Before Black Friday… and Launch
articles.summary: Amazon dropped the price of the upcoming Magic: The Gathering Star Trek Play Booster Box by 40% just days before launch, bringing packs down to effectively $4.17 each ahead of release and the Black Friday sales.
articles.body:
Magic: The Gathering has seen crossovers with Marvel Super Heroes, The Hobbit, and Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles this year alone, but there’s more to come with the final set of 2026: Star Trek.

Taking the long-running card game back to space after last year’s Edge of Eternities, we recently spotted that its Play Booster Box had been discounted heavily before it even launched this week. And yet, just days before it beams onto tabletop matches worldwide, it’s just got another price cut.

Now, though, Amazon has chipped another few bucks off the price , bringing it down to $124.95 — a big 40% drop from the MSRP of $209.70 you’d usually need to fork out for with a Universes Beyond set.

Magic: The Gathering | Star Trek Play Booster Box

Save Even More On Magic’s Newest Set, Star Trek

In terms of pricing per pack, this shakes out at around $4.17 for each Play Booster. That’s a great saving on the MSRP, which would have been $6.99 per pack.

As ever, we need to highlight that you’re much less likely to pack some of the set’s rarest cards in Play Boosters because many of the alternative art treatments are in Collector Boosters.

These are more likely to contain cards worth a lot more, but they retail for around $40 per pack if you can find them, and even then, there’s a good chance they sell for even more than that.

If you’re a Star Trek fan just getting into Magic: The Gathering, this is a great price for a whole host of cards to build a deck with, or to upgrade one of your Commander precons from the set.

For more on Magic: The Gathering, be sure to check out our chat with the Wizards of the Coast team about additional print runs of the Foundations preconstructed decks , and the inspiration for Reality Fracture , this year’s final in-universe set.

For more Magic: The Gathering early Black Friday deals, consider these other top offers on Star Trek. My favorite of the bunch is on the Commander Deck bundle, down to $209.99 .

Not only is that a reduction from its $225 MSRP, but it's a total $90 saving compared to buying each of the new decks individually.

Amazon has announced that its official Black Friday sale kicks off on November 19 , so while we've got some early MTG deals there right now, look forward to even more in the coming days.
